work_experience.description: Developed and maintained 6 microservices in Node.js and Express, serving 200,000+ monthly users. Mentored 3 junior developers and conducted weekly code reviews.

Built responsive front-end interfaces using React, Redux, and Tailwind CSS. Integrated third-party payment gateways and REST APIs. Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest, raising code coverage from 45% to 82%.
Assisted in developing a client dashboard using Vue.js and Firebase. Fixed 40+ UI and functional bugs across two production releases.
